discovery_context: Root proposed the scope question; local square lemma appears in preserved October1 note. Structural reconstructs all implications and two-preimage counting.
statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2), let R count induced rook-nine subsets, U count induced C4 subsets in no such rook, and n3 count induced six-subsets consisting of two disjoint triangles joined by exactly two independent cross edges. Then U=2079-9R, R=231 iff U=0 iff the graph is N3-free, and 0<=n3<=2U=4158-18R.

scope.description: Exact target rook/square/subset counts and parameter-free local lambda1/mu2 square-grid equivalence. No cited global exclusion is approved by this derivation.

assumptions: The graph is complete, finite and simple with exact SRG(99,14,1,2) parameters.
R,U,n3 count actual vertex subsets once, rather than embeddings or automorphism classes.
local_equivalence_scope: Any graph with exact common-neighbor counts lambda1 and mu2; order99/degree14 only enter2079 coefficients.

N3.edge_convention: Increasing lexicographic unordered pairs, first pair low bit

steps: Exact triangle partners and cross matching.
At most one rook around a square.
N3-free forces both opposite edges and compatible ninth point.
An induced N3 has a unique square which cannot be rook-covered.
Each uncovered square has at most two N3 preimages.
4158 nonedges count2079 squares and each rook covers9 disjoint squares.

conditional_cited_consequence.statement: If the exact applicable Makhnev N3-free target exclusion is separately authenticated, R231 is excluded. If the separate R!=230 theorem is also independently accepted, then R<=229 and U>=18.
conditional_cited_consequence.Makhnev_original_scope: Condition(*) forbids exactly two cross edges between two triangles. The matching lemma identifies this with N3-freeness.

limitations: The local theorem does not exclude R231 or a target.
No Hamming covering theorem follows or is substituted.
An uncovered square is not claimed to contain an N3 on its own corners; the implication is global.
N3-to-square map is at most two-to-one, not injective or surjective.
Bare N3 need not itself satisfy the complete common-neighbor hypotheses.
No current ledger/Git/index or frozen evidence bytes are changed.
